components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The single copper call to action; lowercase command copy.
components.css: .ds-btn { font-family: var(--font-mono, 'JetBrains Mono', monospace); font-size: 0.85rem; padding: 0.5rem 1rem; border-radius: var(--radius-sm, 3px); cursor: pointer; transition: border-color 150ms ease-out, color 150ms ease-out, background-color 150ms ease-out; } .ds-btn--primary { background: var(--color-accent, #8a4f24); color: var(--color-bg, #faf7f2); border: 1px solid var(--color-accent, #8a4f24); } .ds-btn--primary:hover, .ds-btn--primary:active { background: var(--color-accent-hover, #7a4622); border-color: var(--color-accent-hover, #7a4622); } .ds-btn--primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-accent, #8a4f24); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Secondary action; hairline border that shifts to copper on hover.
components.css: .ds-btn { font-family: var(--font-mono, 'JetBrains Mono', monospace); font-size: 0.85rem; padding: 0.5rem 1rem; border-radius: var(--radius-sm, 3px); cursor: pointer; transition: border-color 150ms ease-out, color 150ms ease-out; } .ds-btn--ghost { background: transparent; color: var(--color-text, #2c2825); border: 1px solid var(--color-border, #d5cec4); } .ds-btn--ghost:hover { color: var(--color-accent, #8a4f24); border-color: var(--color-accent, #8a4f24); } .ds-btn--ghost:active { color: var(--color-accent-hover, #7a4622); border-color: var(--color-accent-hover, #7a4622); } .ds-btn--ghost:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-accent, #8a4f24); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Tag
components.description: Monospace chip on subtle paper; interactive tags shift to copper.
components.css: .ds-tag { font-family: var(--font-mono, 'JetBrains Mono', monospace); font-size: 0.8rem; padding: 0.15em 0.55em; border-radius: var(--radius-sm, 3px); background: var(--color-bg-subtle, #f0ebe3); border: 1px solid var(--color-border, #d5cec4); color: var(--color-text-muted, #6b5f54); text-decoration: none; cursor: pointer; transition: border-color 150ms ease-out, color 150ms ease-out; } .ds-tag:hover { color: var(--color-accent, #8a4f24); border-color: var(--color-accent, #8a4f24); } .ds-tag:active { color: var(--color-accent-hover, #7a4622); border-color: var(--color-accent-hover, #7a4622); } .ds-tag:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-accent, #8a4f24); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Status Badge
components.description: UPPERCASE mono badge; status color paired with the word, never color alone.
components.css: .ds-status { font-family: var(--font-mono, 'JetBrains Mono', monospace); font-size: 0.72rem; padding: 0.1em 0.5em; border-radius: var(--radius-sm, 3px); text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.05em; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-status--active { color: var(--color-status-ok, #006800); background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-status-ok, #006800) 12%, transparent); border: 1px solid var(--color-status-ok, #006800); }

components.name: Project Card
components.description: Flat container; tonal fill + hairline border, no shadow. The inner link takes the focus ring.
components.html:
marchyo

Personal spin of Omarchy with NixOS.
components.css: .ds-card { border: 1px solid var(--color-border, #d5cec4); border-radius: var(--radius-md, 4px); padding: 1rem; background: var(--color-surface-raised, #fefdfb); font-family: var(--font-body, 'Literata', serif); } .ds-card__title { font-family: var(--font-mono, 'JetBrains Mono', monospace); font-size: 0.95rem; font-weight: 600; color: var(--color-text-heading, #1e1b18); margin: 0 0 0.25rem; } .ds-card__title a { color: inherit; text-decoration: none; } .ds-card__title a:hover { color: var(--color-accent-hover, #7a4622); } .ds-card__title a:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-accent, #8a4f24); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-card__desc { font-size: 0.85rem; color: var(--color-text-muted, #6b5f54); margin: 0; line-height: 1.45; }

components.name: Input Field
components.description: Mono field on paper; border strengthens on hover, shifts to copper on focus.
components.css: .ds-field { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 0.25rem; font-family: var(--font-mono, 'JetBrains Mono', monospace); } .ds-field__label { font-size: 0.75rem; color: var(--color-text, #2c2825); } .ds-field__input { font-family: var(--font-mono, 'JetBrains Mono', monospace); font-size: 0.85rem; color: var(--color-text, #2c2825); background: var(--color-bg, #faf7f2); border: 1px solid var(--color-border, #d5cec4); border-radius: var(--radius-sm, 3px); padding: 0.5rem; box-sizing: border-box; transition: border-color 150ms ease-out; } .ds-field__input::placeholder { color: var(--color-text-muted, #6b5f54); } .ds-field__input:hover { border-color: var(--color-border-strong, #b0a898); } .ds-field__input:focus { outline: 2px solid var(--color-accent, #8a4f24); outline-offset: 2px; border-color: var(--color-accent, #8a4f24); }

components.name: Callout
components.description: The '// currently' pattern: 8% copper tint, hairline copper border, lowercase mono label, copper › bullets.
components.html:
currently

  • building a warm-paper design system
  • reading everything in the queue
components.css: .ds-callout { background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-accent, #8a4f24) 8%, transparent); border: 1px solid var(--color-accent, #8a4f24); border-radius: var(--radius-md, 4px); padding: 1rem 1.5rem; font-family: var(--font-body, 'Literata', serif); } .ds-callout__label { font-family: var(--font-mono, 'JetBrains Mono', monospace); font-size: 0.8rem; text-transform: lowercase; letter-spacing: 0.08em; color: var(--color-text-muted, #6b5f54); margin: 0 0 0.5rem; } .ds-callout__label::before { content: '// '; } .ds-callout ul { list-style: none; padding: 0; margin: 0; } .ds-callout li { position: relative; padding: 0.3rem 0 0.3rem 1.5em; font-size: 0.95rem; } .ds-callout li::before { content: '›'; position: absolute; left: 0; color: var(--color-accent, #8a4f24); font-family: var(--font-mono, 'JetBrains Mono', monospace); }

components.name: Terminal
components.description: Mono session frame; prompt chevron is always copper (the ANSI-11 rule). Output color is never the accent.
components.html:
~/projects
~/projects ❯ ls -la
drwxr-xr-x  design  marchyo  jotain
components.css: .ds-term { border: 1px solid var(--color-border-strong, #b0a898); border-radius: var(--radius-md, 4px); background: var(--color-surface, #e8e1d6); font-family: var(--font-mono, 'JetBrains Mono', monospace); overflow: hidden; } .ds-term__title { font-size: 0.72rem; color: var(--color-text-muted, #6b5f54); letter-spacing: 0.04em; padding: 0.5rem 1rem; border-bottom: 1px dashed var(--color-border, #d5cec4); } .ds-term__body { padding: 0.5rem 1rem; font-size: 0.85rem; line-height: 1.6; } .ds-term__line { display: flex; align-items: baseline; white-space: pre-wrap; } .ds-term__cwd { color: var(--color-text-muted, #6b5f54); } .ds-term__chev { color: var(--color-accent, #8a4f24); font-weight: 700; } .ds-term__cmd { color: var(--color-text, #2c2825); font-weight: 500; } .ds-term__out { margin: 0.125rem 0 0; padding: 0; font: inherit; color: var(--color-text-muted, #6b5f54); white-space: pre-wrap; }

narrative.overview:
This is one engineer's technical notebook, printed on warm cream paper and kept by hand. The page is never white and the ink is never black; everything is set in the tools of the trade. Headings, labels, dates, and chrome are monospace, as if typed at a terminal; long-form prose is a warm serif, as if the notebook were also a book worth reading. A single copper stamp is the only color that speaks, and it speaks rarely. The chrome is borrowed honestly from the surfaces the owner lives in all day: man-page headers, shell prompts (jy ❯), code-editor gutters, tree lines, and // margin comments.

The system is deliberately small and slow-changing, and the restraint is the personality. There are two themes and only two: Paper (warm cream light) and Roast (dark roast), both first-class, both tuned independently for warmth rather than mirrored. Components feel tool-honest and utilitarian — functional first, unfussy, every affordance earning its place. Depth is a lie the system refuses to tell: no shadows, no gradients, no glass. Elevation is four steps of background color and a 1px hairline border, nothing more. Motion follows the 'ink draws on' grammar — nothing fades or floats; a rule draws left-to-right, a label types on, a copper caret blinks, and everything else is a color or translate shift on an ease-out curve.
keyCharacteristics: Warm cream paper and dark roast — never pure white, never pure black.
One copper accent, reserved for interaction and the maker's mark; never a syntax color.
Monospace chrome (JetBrains Mono) over serif prose (Literata); no sans-serif exists.
Flat by doctrine: elevation is background steps + 1px borders, never shadow.
Unicode glyphs are the icon set; the mark is pure type: jy ❯.
Both themes ship together, always; accessibility is a mechanical contract, not a claim.

rules.name: The One Voice Rule
rules.body: There is exactly one accent, copper, and no screen may introduce a second. Its rarity is what lets it mean 'interact here.'

rules.name: The Copper-Is-Not-Code Rule
rules.body: The brand copper never appears inside a code block and is never a syntax color. The syntax palette is a contract with editor users; the accent is a contract with the reader.

rules.name: The Never-Pure Rule
rules.body: No pure white and no pure black anywhere on a surface. White and black exist only as ink that must bleed through, never as the page.

rules.name: The Two-Font Rule
rules.body: Literata serif for prose, JetBrains Mono for everything else. No third family, and never a sans-serif.

rules.name: The Mono-Chrome Rule
rules.body: Navigation, breadcrumbs, labels, dates, tags, and every // margin note are monospace. If it is chrome, it is mono; if it is prose, it is serif.

rules.name: The Oldstyle-In-Prose Rule
rules.body: Numbers in serif prose use oldstyle figures; numbers in mono chrome and code reset to lining figures so columns stay aligned.

rules.name: The Flat Paper Rule
rules.body: If something needs to feel raised, step it up one Paperstock level. Never add a shadow, never fake a lift. Elevation is color, not light.

rules.name: The Small-Radius Rule
rules.body: Nothing rounder than 4px on a container, and no pill buttons. The system's edges are crisp, like cut paper.

dos: Do set html { background: var(--color-bg); color: var(--color-text); } and let everything inherit.
Do convey elevation by stepping bg → bg-subtle → surface → surface-raised, plus a 1px border.
Do use accent for anything interactive that has no color of its own; use accent-hover only for hover/active.
Do render code with the Modus syntax tokens so blocks match Emacs, bat, delta, and the Charm TUIs.
Do ship every interactive primitive with hover, :focus-visible, active, and — where inert — disabled and loading (aria-busy + mono ellipsis).
Do ship both themes together; keep body text AAA, meta AA, and text-faint decorative only.
Do pair every status color with a glyph + word (alerts) or a // label (callouts).
donts: Don't add a shadow, a gradient, a backdrop-filter, or glass. Elevation is color, never light.
Don't introduce a second accent, or use text-faint for body copy.
Don't pick a color from the syntax palette because you like the hue — it is a contract with editor users.
Don't introduce a sans-serif, or a type size outside the ten-step scale.
Don't ship pill buttons or a 12–16px rounded-card aesthetic; radii stop at 4px on containers.
Don't ship a tinted status card without its label, and never a decorative 3px side-stripe (that stroke is the selected-item marker only).
Don't use emoji, an icon font, or an SVG sprite; default to a Unicode glyph, and only draw a thin square-capped currentColor SVG if a glyph genuinely cannot.
Don't duplicate a hex value in consumer code — every color derives from tokens.json.
